name: Android rejected draft Settings and same-scope re-pair lifecycle
timestampBasis: Native log filesystem creation time through retained host/lint report modification time.
summary: Six maintained actual Compose/JNI cases passed, including real AppRoot Settings/manual PairScreen recovery, activity recreation, and different-workspace/server isolation; 33 debug and 33 release JVM cases and release lint passed.
scope: Owned fresh API36/16KB debug emulator through HTTP response fixtures and actual native PairScreen/JNI. Partial P002/P003/P006 contribution only. Not actual server JWT expiry/revocation, complete eight-case isolated/hosted automatic run, signed candidate, physical phone, Play or public-install acceptance.
sourceStatusAtVerification: Product/test files were edited before execution, automatically committed afterward and byte-matched at readback; this is not a signed release build manifest.
countBasis: JUnit testcase nodes and failure/error/skipped nodes in retained XML; lint issue severity Error/Fatal; maintained guard scripts report their actual enumerated fixture populations. Guard counts are fixture tests, not native/server journeys.

rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: OperatorChatScreen owns its composer in local remember; actual shell route changes and null-credential re-pair dispose that state.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The rejected send never restores its draft, or PairScreen recovery fails before a fresh paired shell appears.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: Reach and assert the restored auth-rejected draft; navigate the real Settings branch, then return directly or manually re-pair to the same server/workspace, and inspect EditableText. Repeat after moving draft ownership above route/pairing disposal.
rootCauseVerification.testProcedure: Maintained OperatorChatScreenTest class on owned API36/16KB emulator; unchanged product corrected-fixture baseline followed by fixed source run. Cross-server/workspace controls and explicit fresh-token retry use real JNI through MockWebServer.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: Draft is present immediately after rejection but empty after Settings or successful same-scope re-pair; hoisted scoped saved state retains it, including activity recreation.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: Initial restored-draft assertion or pairing/shell return fails before the post-transition composer assertion.

rootCauseVerification.actualObservation: Corrected baseline: 4 pass and 2 fail with empty EditableText after Settings and successful same-scope re-pair. Fixed: all 6 pass, including same-scope recreation, no automatic replay, fresh-token explicit retry, and empty draft across different workspace/server.
rootCauseVerification.testResult: Confirmed lifecycle disposal; native 6/6 pass, JVM 33 debug + 33 release pass, release lint zero errors; guard suites pass.
rootCauseVerification.harnessAudit: First attempt: lazy Forget action was uncomposed; fixed maintained fixture with performScrollToNode before click. Second baseline isolated product loss. Each attempt retains separate logs/XML; preflight checks clean pairing, notification grant, emulator boot/API36/16KB. Reply fixture returns persisted history so success does not depend on a transient bubble. No unchanged rerun after diagnosis.

assertions.evidence: Six actual Compose/JNI tests executed without failure/error/skip; two corrected-baseline lifecycle losses become passes. Real shell Settings/manual PairScreen transitions and recreation are covered, but server JWT verifier is not.

Same server/workspace preserves draft through new token/device identity; different workspace/server presents empty EditableText; navigation/pairing sends nothing until explicit retry, using the fresh token.
Retained JUnit reports contain 33 debug and 33 release testcase nodes, no failures/errors/skips; release lint reports zero Error/Fatal issues.

Paired proof barrier 43 refusal/acceptance controls, live fixture guards 36, isolated runtime stubs 8, CI mutation controls 32 and runner mutations 15 pass. Exact eight-case actual isolated/hosted execution remains required.
Each native fixture clears only its owned stored device; service android-wi10005614 inactive/dead, AVD and ini absent, emulator-5586 absent from adb inventory.
